text.en:
Singapore Armed Forces Act
(Chapter 295)
and
Singapore Armed Forces
(Pensions) Regulations (Rg 9 — regulation 13)
Appointment of Members of the Pensions Appeal Tribunal
N 3
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
[9th June 1989]
The Armed Forces Council has appointed —
(a)the Permanent Secretary and the Deputy Secretary of the Ministry of Defence; and
(b)the Director of the Public Service Division of the Prime Minister’s Office,
to be members of the Pensions Appeal Tribunal.
